es.B: Entonces el capitán fue con sus guardias y trajo a los apóstoles. No usaron la fuerza, porque tenían miedo de la gente y de que los apedrearan.
es.R: Así que el jefe de la guardia y sus hombres fueron y trajeron otra vez a los apóstoles. Pero no los maltrataron ni los obligaron a venir. Tenían miedo de que la gente les tirara piedras.

fr.L: Alors le commandant partit avec les gardes et les amena, [mais] sans violence, car ils craignaient le peuple, de peur d’être lapidés.
fr.B: Le commandant partit alors avec ses gardes et ramena les apôtres. Ils n’usèrent pas de violence, car ils avaient peur de la foule et d’être lapidés.
fr.R: Le chef des gardes et ses hommes sont donc allés chercher les apôtres. Mais ils ne leur ont pas fait de mal et ne les ont pas forcés à venir. Ils avaient peur que les gens leur jettent des pierres.

sw.L: Kisha mkuu [wa walinzi] akaenda pamoja na walinzi, akawaleta, si kwa nguvu, kwa maana waliwaogopa watu, wasije wakapigwa mawe.
sw.B: Basi mkuu wa walinzi alikwenda pamoja na walinzi wake, akawaleta mitume. Hawakutumia nguvu, kwa sababu waliwaogopa watu, wasije wakapigwa mawe.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo mkuu wa walinzi na watu wake walikwenda wakawarudisha mitume. Lakini hawakuwaumiza wala kuwalazimisha kuja. Waliogopa kwamba watu wangewapiga mawe.

decisions.choice: lest they be stoned: the officers feared being stoned by the people
decisions.reason: "They" are the captain and his officers. The people honored the apostles (5:13), and a crowd might have turned on anyone who mistreated them.

decisions.choice: stoned: killed or attacked with stones by a crowd
decisions.reason: Stoning was the law's penalty for some crimes (Leviticus 24:16), but crowds also used it in anger (14:19; Luke 20:6).

decisions.choice: not with force: without violence
decisions.reason: They brought them back without seizing them roughly.

decisions.choice: throw stones at them
decisions.reason: Readable says what stoning was.

source.text: Ἀγαγόντες δὲ αὐτοὺς ἔστησαν ἐν τῷ συνεδρίῳ.

records.literal_gloss: Having brought then them they stood [them] in the council.

en.L: And having brought them, they stood [them] in the council.
en.B: They brought them in and stood them before the council.
en.R: They brought the apostles in and made them stand in front of the council.

es.L: Y habiéndolos traído, [los] presentaron en el concilio.
es.B: Los trajeron y los hicieron comparecer ante el Consejo.
es.R: Trajeron a los apóstoles y los hicieron ponerse de pie delante del Consejo Supremo.

fr.L: Et les ayant amenés, ils [les] placèrent dans le Sanhédrin.
fr.B: Ils les firent entrer et les placèrent devant le Sanhédrin.
fr.R: Ils ont fait entrer les apôtres et les ont fait se tenir debout devant le grand conseil.

sw.L: Na walipokwisha kuwaleta, wakawasimamisha katika baraza.
sw.B: Waliwaleta, wakawasimamisha mbele ya baraza.
sw.R: Waliwaleta mitume, wakawasimamisha mbele ya baraza kuu.

decisions.choice: stood them in the council: brought them to trial
decisions.reason: The accused stood before the council, as Peter and John did in 4:7.

source.text: καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτοὺς ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς λέγων· Παραγγελίᾳ παρηγγείλαμεν ὑμῖν μὴ διδάσκειν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τούτῳ, καὶ ἰδοὺ πεπληρώκατε τὴν Ἰερουσαλὴμ τῆς διδαχῆς ὑμῶν, καὶ βούλεσθε ἐπαγαγεῖν ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς τὸ αἷμα τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τούτου.

records.literal_gloss: And asked them the high priest \v 28 saying, With a charge we charged you not to teach in the name this, and behold you have filled the Jerusalem with the teaching of you, and you intend to bring upon us the blood of the man this.

en.L: And the high priest questioned them, \v 28 saying, "We strictly charged you not to teach in this name, and look, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and you intend to bring the blood of this man upon us."
en.B: The high priest began to question them: \v 28 "We ordered you in no uncertain terms to stop teaching in this name. Now look: your teaching has spread all through Jerusalem, and you are set on laying this man's blood at our door."
en.R: The high priest questioned them. \v 28 He said, "We told you clearly that you must not teach about this man. But you have spread your teaching all over Jerusalem! And you want people to blame us for his death."

es.L: Y el sumo sacerdote les preguntó, \v 28 diciendo: «{{plural_you:Les|Os}} mandamos con mandato no enseñar en este nombre, y {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, {{plural_you:han llenado|habéis llenado}} Jerusalén de {{plural_you:la enseñanza de ustedes|vuestra enseñanza}}, y {{plural_you:quieren|queréis}} traer sobre nosotros la sangre de este hombre».
es.B: El sumo sacerdote comenzó a interrogarlos: \v 28 «{{plural_you:Les|Os}} dimos órdenes terminantes de no seguir enseñando en este nombre. Y ahora {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}: {{plural_you:han llenado|habéis llenado}} toda Jerusalén con {{plural_you:la enseñanza de ustedes|vuestra enseñanza}}, y {{plural_you:están decididos|estáis decididos}} a cargarnos la culpa de la sangre de este hombre».
es.R: El sumo sacerdote los interrogó. \v 28 Les dijo: «{{plural_you:Les|Os}} dijimos claramente que no {{plural_you:debían|debíais}} enseñar acerca de este hombre. ¡Pero {{plural_you:han difundido|habéis difundido}} {{plural_you:la enseñanza de ustedes|vuestra enseñanza}} por toda Jerusalén! Y {{plural_you:quieren|queréis}} que la gente nos culpe de su muerte».

fr.L: Et le grand prêtre les interrogea, \v 28 disant : « Nous vous avons formellement ordonné de ne pas enseigner en ce nom, et voici, vous avez rempli Jérusalem de votre enseignement, et vous voulez faire retomber sur nous le sang de cet homme. »
fr.B: Le grand prêtre se mit à les interroger : \v 28 « Nous vous avions donné l’ordre exprès de ne plus enseigner en ce nom. Et voilà que votre enseignement s’est répandu dans tout Jérusalem, et vous êtes décidés à nous mettre sur le dos le sang de cet homme ! »
fr.R: Le grand prêtre leur a posé des questions. \v 28 Il leur a dit : « Nous vous avons clairement dit de ne pas enseigner au sujet de cet homme. Mais vous avez répandu votre enseignement dans tout Jérusalem ! Et vous voulez que les gens nous accusent de sa mort. »

sw.L: Na kuhani mkuu akawauliza, \v 28 akisema, "Tuliwaagiza kwa agizo kwamba msifundishe kwa jina hili, na tazameni, mmeijaza Yerusalemu mafundisho yenu, na mnataka kuleta juu yetu damu ya mtu huyu."
sw.B: Kuhani mkuu alianza kuwahoji: \v 28 "Tuliwapa amri kali mwache kufundisha kwa jina hili. Sasa tazameni: mafundisho yenu yameenea Yerusalemu yote, nanyi mmekusudia kututwika lawama ya damu ya mtu huyu."
sw.R: Kuhani mkuu aliwahoji. \v 28 Alisema, "Tuliwaambia wazi kwamba msifundishe habari za mtu huyu. Lakini mmeeneza mafundisho yenu kila mahali Yerusalemu! Tena mnataka watu watulaumu sisi kwa kifo chake."

decisions.choice: we charged you with a charge: we gave you strict orders
alternatives: we charged you with a crime
decisions.reason: Repeating the verb with its own noun makes it emphatic, as in Luke 22:15, "with desire I have desired". The order is the one given in 4:17-18.

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: a statement, "We strictly charged you"
alternatives: many manuscripts add "not", making it a question: "Did we not strictly charge you?"
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts, followed by the King James Version, read it as a question. Others, some of them early, have the statement. Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: this name; this man: the high priest avoids saying "Jesus"
decisions.reason: He speaks of Jesus without naming him. The apostles name him plainly (5:30).

decisions.choice: bring this man's blood upon us: make us guilty of his death
alternatives: bring a curse of bloodshed upon us
decisions.reason: "Blood on" someone means guilt for a death (2 Samuel 1:16; Matthew 27:25). The apostles have said the leaders killed Jesus (4:10).

decisions.choice: laying this man's blood at our door (B); blame us for his death (R)
alternatives: bring this man's blood upon us
decisions.reason: Balanced uses an English idiom with the same sense; Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: teach about this man
decisions.reason: Readable says what teaching "in this name" meant: teaching about Jesus by his authority.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:la enseñanza de ustedes|vuestra enseñanza}}
decisions.reason: "Su enseñanza" could be read as "his teaching", the teaching of the man the high priest will not name (meaning decision m3), so the default spells out "de ustedes".

source.text: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Πέτρος καὶ οἱ ἀπόστολοι εἶπαν· Πειθαρχεῖν δεῖ θεῷ μᾶλλον ἢ ἀνθρώποις.

records.literal_gloss: Answering but Peter and the apostles said, To obey it is necessary God rather than men.

en.L: But Peter and the apostles answered and said, "[We] must obey God rather than {{gender:people|men}}.
en.B: Peter and the other apostles replied, "It is God we must obey rather than people.
en.R: Peter and the other apostles answered, "We have to do what God says, not what people say.

es.L: Pero respondiendo Pedro y los apóstoles, dijeron: «Obedecer a Dios es necesario, más que a {{gender:las personas|los hombres}}.
es.B: Pedro y los otros apóstoles respondieron: «Es a Dios a quien debemos obedecer, más que a los seres humanos.
es.R: Pedro y los otros apóstoles contestaron: «Tenemos que hacer lo que Dios dice, no lo que dice la gente.

fr.L: Mais Pierre et les apôtres répondirent et dirent : « Il faut obéir à Dieu plutôt qu’{{gender:aux humains|aux hommes}}.
fr.B: Pierre et les autres apôtres répondirent : « C’est à Dieu qu’il nous faut obéir, plutôt qu’aux êtres humains.
fr.R: Pierre et les autres apôtres ont répondu : « Nous devons faire ce que Dieu dit, et non ce que les gens disent.

sw.L: Lakini Petro na mitume wakajibu, wakasema, "Ni lazima kumtii Mungu zaidi kuliko wanadamu.
sw.B: Petro na mitume wengine walijibu, "Ni Mungu tunayepaswa kumtii kuliko wanadamu.
sw.R: Petro na mitume wengine walijibu, "Ni lazima tufanye anachosema Mungu, si wanachosema watu.

decisions.choice: obey: to obey one who has authority
decisions.reason: The verb is used of obeying a ruler. They own the council's authority, but God's comes first. The same verb comes in 5:32.

decisions.choice: obey God rather than people: what Peter and John said in 4:19
decisions.reason: They had told the council the same before (4:19-20).

decisions.choice: Peter and the apostles: Peter speaks for them all
decisions.reason: Peter is their spokesman, as in 2:14.

decisions.choice: people: human beings, as against God
decisions.reason: The word means human beings in general.

decisions.choice: people, with "men" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As at 5:4.

decisions.choice: the other apostles
decisions.reason: Peter is himself an apostle.

source.text: ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ἤγειρεν Ἰησοῦν, ὃν ὑμεῖς διεχειρίσασθε κρεμάσαντες ἐπὶ ξύλου·

records.literal_gloss: The God of the fathers of us raised Jesus, whom you killed having hanged on a tree.

en.L: The God of our fathers raised Jesus, whom you killed by hanging [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}] on a tree.
en.B: The God of our {{gender:ancestors|fathers}} raised Jesus, whom you had done away with by hanging {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} on a tree.
en.R: The God our {{gender:ancestors|fathers}} worshiped brought Jesus back to life. You had killed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} by nailing {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to a cross.

es.L: El Dios de nuestros padres levantó a Jesús, a quien {{plural_you:ustedes mataron|vosotros matasteis}} colgándo[lo] de un madero.
es.B: El Dios de nuestros {{gender:antepasados|padres}} levantó a Jesús, a quien {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:habían eliminado|habíais eliminado}} colgándolo de un madero.
es.R: El Dios al que adoraban nuestros {{gender:antepasados|padres}} le devolvió la vida a Jesús. {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:habían|habíais}} matado clavándolo en una cruz.

fr.L: Le Dieu de nos pères a ressuscité Jésus, que vous avez tué en {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} suspendant au bois.
fr.B: Le Dieu de {{gender:nos ancêtres|nos pères}} a ressuscité Jésus, que vous aviez fait mourir en {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pendant au bois.
fr.R: Le Dieu que {{gender:nos ancêtres|nos pères}} adoraient a ramené Jésus à la vie. Vous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}aviez tué en {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} clouant sur une croix.

sw.L: Mungu wa baba zetu alimfufua Yesu, ambaye ninyi mlimuua kwa kumtundika juu ya mti.
sw.B: Mungu wa mababu zetu alimfufua Yesu, ambaye ninyi mlimuua kwa kumtundika juu ya mti.
sw.R: Mungu ambaye mababu zetu walimwabudu alimfufua Yesu. Ninyi mlikuwa mmemuua kwa kumpigilia misumari msalabani.

decisions.choice: raised: raised from the dead
decisions.reason: The verb is the usual one for raising the dead (3:15, 10:40, 13:30), set against "whom you killed". It can also mean raising up a leader (13:22), and some read it so here.

decisions.choice: hanging him on a tree: the cross, as the law speaks of one hanged on a tree
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 21:22-23 says that one hanged on a tree is under God's curse. Peter uses the same words in 10:39, and Paul in 13:29 and Galatians 3:13. The leaders meant the cross as a curse; God raised him.

decisions.choice: killed: laid violent hands on, murdered
decisions.reason: The verb means to kill with one's own hands (26:21).

decisions.choice: our fathers: our forebears
decisions.reason: The forebears of Israel, as in 3:13.

decisions.choice: ancestors, with "fathers" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As at 3:13; Literal keeps the Greek word.

decisions.choice: brought back to life; nailing him to a cross
decisions.reason: Readable says what the words refer to, as the meaning notes explain.

decisions.choice: levantó (L, B); le devolvió la vida (R)
decisions.reason: As the English "raised": Spanish "levantar" can mean raising from the dead and raising up, as the Greek verb can (meaning decision m1, uncertain); Readable says the sense the meaning decision prefers.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans on free pronouns only (lo); none on pronouns joined to the verb (colgándolo, clavándolo)
alternatives: a span for every pronoun the English marks
decisions.reason: A pronoun joined to the verb cannot take a capital, so Spanish has fewer spans than the English in this chapter.

decisions.choice: alimfufua
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m1 reads the verb as raising from the dead (uncertain). "Kumwinua" would say only lifting up or exalting, so Swahili says "kufufua" at every level, where the English "raised" can carry both.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span on verbs (mlimuua, kumtundika); spans only on free pronouns and possessives
alternatives: a span for every pronoun the English marks
decisions.reason: Swahili marks the pronoun for Jesus inside the verb, and a prefix cannot take a capital, so only free pronouns and possessives (wake) carry the setting in this chapter, and Swahili has fewer spans than the English.

source.text: τοῦτον ὁ θεὸς ἀρχηγὸν καὶ σωτῆρα ὕψωσεν τῇ δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ, τοῦ δοῦναι μετάνοιαν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν·

records.literal_gloss: This one the God Leader and Savior exalted to the right hand of him, to give repentance to the Israel and forgiveness of sins.

en.L: This one God exalted to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand [as] Leader and Savior, to give repentance to Israel and forgiveness of sins.
en.B: He is the one God has lifted up to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand as Leader and Savior, to grant Israel repentance and forgiveness of sins.
en.R: God lifted Jesus up to the place of honor at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right side. God made {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} Leader and Savior. He did this so that the people of Israel could be given a change of heart and have their sins forgiven.

es.L: A este, Dios [lo] exaltó a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} diestra [como] Líder y Salvador, para dar arrepentimiento a Israel y perdón de pecados.
es.B: Este es aquel a quien Dios ha exaltado a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecha como Líder y Salvador, para conceder a Israel el arrepentimiento y el perdón de los pecados.
es.R: Dios levantó a Jesús al lugar de honor a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecha. Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} hizo Líder y Salvador. Lo hizo para que el pueblo de Israel pudiera cambiar de corazón y recibir el perdón de sus pecados.

fr.L: C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que Dieu a élevé à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite [comme] Chef et Sauveur, pour donner à Israël la repentance et le pardon des péchés.
fr.B: C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que Dieu a élevé à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite comme Chef et Sauveur, pour accorder à Israël la repentance et le pardon des péchés.
fr.R: Dieu a élevé Jésus à la place d’honneur, à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite. Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a fait Chef et Sauveur. Il a fait cela pour que le peuple d’Israël puisse changer de vie et recevoir le pardon de ses péchés.

sw.L: Huyu Mungu alimwinua [hadi] upande {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kulia [kuwa] Kiongozi na Mwokozi, ili kuwapa Israeli toba na msamaha wa dhambi.
sw.B: Huyu ndiye ambaye Mungu amemwinua hadi upande {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kulia kuwa Kiongozi na Mwokozi, ili awajalie Israeli toba na msamaha wa dhambi.
sw.R: Mungu alimwinua Yesu hadi mahali pa heshima upande {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kulia. Mungu alimfanya kuwa Kiongozi na Mwokozi. Alifanya hivyo ili watu wa Israeli wapate kubadilika mioyo na kusamehewa dhambi zao.

decisions.choice: Leader: the one who goes first and leads his people
decisions.reason: The word means a leader or founder. In 3:15 it is "the Author of life". Here, paired with "Savior", the sense of leader and ruler comes forward.

decisions.choice: to his right hand: lifted to the place beside God
decisions.reason: As in 2:33, the form can mean "to" or "by".

decisions.choice: Savior: a title of God, now given to Jesus
decisions.reason: God is called Savior in Isaiah 45:21 and Luke 1:47; Jesus in Luke 2:11 and Acts 13:23.

decisions.choice: to give repentance: repentance itself is God's gift
decisions.reason: In 11:18 the believers say God has given repentance to the nations too. The giver may be God or the exalted Jesus; the sentence does not say which.

decisions.choice: a change of heart
decisions.reason: Readable says what repentance is, in plain words.

decisions.choice: three short sentences
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the Greek sentence into steps, naming Jesus.

decisions.choice: Líder
decisions.reason: The title means the one who goes first and leads his people (meaning decision m1, uncertain). "Príncipe" today suggests a king's son; "Líder" says what he does.

decisions.choice: Chef
decisions.reason: "Prince" is the traditional French word but now suggests a king's son; "Chef" says the one who goes first and leads his people (m1). A reviewer may prefer "Guide".

decisions.choice: la repentance (L, B); changer de vie (R)
alternatives: changer de cœur (R), as the English "a change of heart"
decisions.reason: The style guide's term (§9). "Changer de cœur" is not idiomatic French for repenting; "changer de vie" is the Readable form the term sheet gives.

decisions.choice: Kiongozi
decisions.reason: The title means the one who goes first and leads his people (meaning decision m1, uncertain). "Kiongozi" (leader, one who leads the way) says that; "Mkuu" would say only that he is the chief.

source.text: καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν μάρτυρες τῶν ῥημάτων τούτων, καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον ὃ ἔδωκεν ὁ θεὸς τοῖς πειθαρχοῦσιν αὐτῷ.

records.literal_gloss: And we are witnesses of the things these, and the Spirit the Holy whom gave the God to those obeying him.

en.L: And we are witnesses of these things, and [so is] the Holy Spirit, whom God gave to those obeying {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: We ourselves testify to these things, and so does the Holy Spirit, given by God to all who obey {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: We saw these things happen, and we tell people about them. The Holy Spirit also shows that they are true. God has given the Spirit to everyone who obeys {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y nosotros somos testigos de estas cosas, y [también lo es] el Espíritu Santo, que Dios dio a los que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} obedecen».
es.B: Nosotros mismos somos testigos de estas cosas, y también lo es el Espíritu Santo, que Dios ha dado a todos los que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} obedecen».
es.R: Nosotros vimos suceder estas cosas, y se las contamos a la gente. El Espíritu Santo también muestra que son verdad. Dios ha dado el Espíritu a todos los que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} obedecen».

fr.L: Et nous sommes témoins de ces choses, et [l’est aussi] l’Esprit Saint, que Dieu a donné à ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéissent. »
fr.B: Nous-mêmes, nous rendons témoignage de ces faits, et l’Esprit Saint aussi, que Dieu a donné à tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéissent. »
fr.R: Nous avons vu ces choses arriver, et nous en parlons aux gens. L’Esprit Saint montre lui aussi qu’elles sont vraies. Dieu a donné l’Esprit à tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéissent. »

sw.L: Nasi tu mashahidi wa mambo haya, na [ndivyo alivyo] Roho Mtakatifu, ambaye Mungu amewapa wale wanaomtii."
sw.B: Sisi wenyewe tunashuhudia mambo haya, na Roho Mtakatifu pia, ambaye Mungu amewapa wote wanaomtii."
sw.R: Tuliyaona mambo haya yakitokea, na tunawaeleza watu habari hizo. Roho Mtakatifu pia anaonyesha kwamba ni kweli. Mungu amewapa Roho huyo wote wanaomtii."

decisions.choice: these things: the events Peter has named
decisions.reason: The word can mean words or matters. Here it means the death, raising and exaltation of Jesus (5:30-31), as in Luke 2:15.

decisions.choice: the Holy Spirit is also a witness
alternatives: the Spirit only helps the apostles
decisions.reason: Jesus said the Spirit would testify about him, and so would his followers (John 15:26-27; Acts 1:8). The signs and the gift of the Spirit back up the apostles' words.

decisions.choice: those who obey him: the same verb as in 5:29
decisions.reason: The apostles obey God; the Spirit is given to all who do. The council is implicitly invited to obey as well.

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "we are witnesses"
alternatives: some manuscripts read "we are his witnesses"
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts, followed by the King James Version ("we are his witnesses of these things"), add a word meaning "his" or "in him". Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: we saw these things happen, and we tell people about them; shows that they are true
alternatives: we are witnesses; and the Holy Spirit
decisions.reason: Readable says what being a witness means, and what the Spirit's witness is, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: the quotation opened at 5:29 closes here
decisions.reason: Peter's answer runs over four records (5:29-32) and ends here, before the narrative resumes in 5:33, so French closes the quotation marks. The English records leave it open, which a reviewer may want to correct.

source.text: Οἱ δὲ ἀκούσαντες διεπρίοντο καὶ ἐβούλοντο ἀνελεῖν αὐτούς.

records.literal_gloss: Those but having heard were being sawn through and were wanting to kill them.

en.L: And when they heard [this], they were cut to the quick and wanted to kill them.
en.B: Hearing this, the council members were enraged and were ready to have the apostles killed.
en.R: When the council members heard this, they became very angry. They wanted to kill the apostles.

es.L: Y los que [lo] oyeron se reconcomían de rabia y querían matarlos.
es.B: Al oír esto, los miembros del Consejo se enfurecieron y estaban dispuestos a hacer matar a los apóstoles.
es.R: Cuando los miembros del Consejo Supremo oyeron esto, se enojaron muchísimo. Querían matar a los apóstoles.

fr.L: Et eux, ayant entendu, furent ulcérés et voulaient les tuer.
fr.B: En entendant cela, les membres du Sanhédrin furent pris de rage et voulaient faire mourir les apôtres.
fr.R: Quand les membres du grand conseil ont entendu cela, ils se sont mis très en colère. Ils voulaient tuer les apôtres.

sw.L: Nao waliposikia [hayo], walijawa na hasira kali, wakataka kuwaua.
sw.B: Wajumbe wa baraza waliposikia hayo walighadhibika, wakataka kuwaua mitume.
sw.R: Wajumbe wa baraza kuu waliposikia hayo walikasirika sana. Walitaka kuwaua mitume.

decisions.choice: cut to the quick: furious
decisions.reason: The verb means to be sawn through. In 7:54 it is used again of rage. The crowd at Pentecost was "pierced to the heart" and repented (2:37); these hearers are torn by anger instead.

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "they wanted"
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts, followed by the King James Version ("took counsel to slay them"), have a similar verb meaning "they were planning". Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: the council members; the apostles
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the people.

decisions.choice: se reconcomían de rabia
decisions.reason: The Greek verb pictures being sawn through; it means they were furious (meaning decision m1). "Reconcomerse" keeps a picture of being eaten away inside and says rage, where "heridos" would suggest hurt feelings.

decisions.choice: walijawa na hasira kali
decisions.reason: The Greek verb pictures being sawn through; it means they were furious (meaning decision m1). "Kuchomwa mioyo" (to be pierced in the heart) would suggest being moved to repent, so Literal says the meaning.

source.text: ἀναστὰς δέ τις ἐν τῷ συνεδρίῳ Φαρισαῖος ὀνόματι Γαμαλιήλ, νομοδιδάσκαλος τίμιος παντὶ τῷ λαῷ, ἐκέλευσεν ἔξω βραχὺ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ποιῆσαι, εἶπέν τε πρὸς αὐτούς· Ἄνδρες Ἰσραηλῖται, προσέχετε ἑαυτοῖς ἐπὶ τοῖς ἀνθρώποις τούτοις τί μέλλετε πράσσειν.

records.literal_gloss: Having risen up but a certain one in the council Pharisee by name Gamaliel, teacher of the law honored by all the people, commanded outside briefly the men to put, \v 35 said and to them, Men Israelites, take heed to yourselves concerning the men these what you are about to do.

en.L: But a certain Pharisee in the council named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law honored by all the people, stood up and ordered the men to be put outside for a short while, \v 35 and he said to them, "Men, Israelites, take heed to yourselves as to what you are about to do to these men.
en.B: But one of the council stood up, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law respected by the whole people. He had the men sent outside for a short time, \v 35 and then he spoke to the council: "Men of Israel, be careful how you deal with these men.
en.R: But one of the council members stood up. He was a Pharisee named Gamaliel. He was a teacher of God's law, and all the people respected him. He told the guards to take the apostles outside for a short time. \v 35 Then he said to the council, "Men of Israel, be careful about what you are planning to do to these men.

es.L: Pero levantándose en el concilio cierto fariseo llamado Gamaliel, maestro de la ley respetado por todo el pueblo, mandó sacar fuera por un momento a los hombres, \v 35 y les dijo: «Hombres israelitas, {{plural_you:miren por ustedes mismos|mirad por vosotros mismos}} en cuanto a lo que {{plural_you:van|vais}} a hacer con estos hombres.
es.B: Pero uno del Consejo se puso de pie, un fariseo llamado Gamaliel, maestro de la ley respetado por todo el pueblo. Mandó que sacaran a los hombres por un rato, \v 35 y luego dijo al Consejo: «Hombres de Israel, {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} cuidado con lo que {{plural_you:van|vais}} a hacer con estos hombres.
es.R: Pero uno de los miembros del Consejo se puso de pie. Era un fariseo llamado Gamaliel. Era maestro de la ley de Dios, y todo el pueblo lo respetaba. Mandó a los guardias que sacaran a los apóstoles por un momento. \v 35 Luego dijo al Consejo: «Hombres de Israel, {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} cuidado con lo que {{plural_you:piensan|pensáis}} hacerles a estos hombres.

fr.L: Mais un Pharisien nommé Gamaliel, membre du Sanhédrin, maître de la Loi honoré de tout le peuple, se leva et ordonna de faire sortir un moment ces hommes, \v 35 et il leur dit : « Hommes israélites, prenez garde à vous-mêmes quant à ce que vous allez faire à ces hommes.
fr.B: Mais un membre du Sanhédrin se leva : c’était un Pharisien nommé Gamaliel, maître de la Loi respecté de tout le peuple. Il fit sortir les apôtres pour un court moment, \v 35 puis il s’adressa au Sanhédrin : « Hommes d’Israël, faites bien attention à la manière dont vous allez traiter ces hommes.
fr.R: Mais l’un des membres du grand conseil s’est levé. C’était un Pharisien qui s’appelait Gamaliel. Il enseignait la Loi de Dieu, et tout le peuple le respectait. Il a dit aux gardes de faire sortir les apôtres pour un petit moment. \v 35 Puis il a dit au grand conseil : « Hommes d’Israël, faites attention à ce que vous avez l’intention de faire à ces hommes.

sw.L: Lakini mmoja katika baraza, Farisayo jina lake Gamalieli, mwalimu wa sheria aliyeheshimiwa na watu wote, akasimama, akaamuru watu hao watolewe nje kwa muda mfupi, \v 35 akawaambia, "Enyi wanaume Waisraeli, jihadharini wenyewe kuhusu yale mnayokusudia kuwatendea watu hawa.
sw.B: Lakini mmoja wa baraza alisimama, Farisayo aitwaye Gamalieli, mwalimu wa sheria aliyeheshimiwa na watu wote. Aliagiza watu hao watolewe nje kwa muda mfupi, \v 35 kisha akaliambia baraza, "Enyi watu wa Israeli, angalieni sana jinsi mtakavyowashughulikia watu hawa.
sw.R: Lakini mmoja wa wajumbe wa baraza kuu alisimama. Alikuwa Farisayo aitwaye Gamalieli. Alikuwa mwalimu wa sheria ya Mungu, na watu wote walimheshimu. Aliwaambia walinzi wawatoe mitume nje kwa muda mfupi. \v 35 Kisha akaliambia baraza, "Enyi watu wa Israeli, kuweni waangalifu kuhusu mnayopanga kuwatendea watu hawa.

decisions.choice: a Pharisee: one of the party known for careful keeping of the law
decisions.reason: The Pharisees kept the law and the traditions of the elders strictly. Unlike the Sadducees, they believed in the resurrection and in angels (23:6-8).

decisions.choice: Gamaliel: a leading teacher of the law in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Paul was taught by him (22:3). Later Jewish tradition remembered him with great honor as Rabban Gamaliel the Elder (Mishnah Sotah 9:15).

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "the men"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts, followed by the King James Version, have "the apostles". The sense is the same. Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: men, Israelites: a formal address to the council
decisions.reason: The same formal address as 2:22 and 3:12, but here it is spoken to the council, whose members were all men. So it is not widened to men and women.

decisions.choice: take heed to yourselves: be careful, for your own sake
decisions.reason: A warning (20:28; Luke 17:3). Gamaliel warns them that they themselves may be at risk (5:39).

decisions.choice: told the guards to take the apostles outside
alternatives: ordered the men to be put outside
decisions.reason: Readable names who did it and who was taken out.

decisions.choice: maître de la Loi
decisions.reason: "Docteur de la Loi" is the traditional phrase but "docteur" now means a physician; "maître" keeps the sense of a respected teacher. "Pharisien" is capitalised, as the style guide sets (§9).

decisions.choice: mwalimu wa sheria
decisions.reason: A teacher of the law of Moses (meaning decision m2), the wording used across the New Testament drafts. "Mwanasheria" would suggest a modern lawyer.

source.text: πρὸ γὰρ τούτων τῶν ἡμερῶν ἀνέστη Θευδᾶς, λέγων εἶναί τινα ἑαυτόν, ᾧ προσεκλίθη ἀνδρῶν ἀριθμὸς ὡς τετρακοσίων· ὃς ἀνῃρέθη, καὶ πάντες ὅσοι ἐπείθοντο αὐτῷ διελύθησαν καὶ ἐγένοντο εἰς οὐδέν.

records.literal_gloss: Before for these the days rose up Theudas, saying to be somebody himself, to whom were joined of men a number about four hundred; who was killed, and all as many as were obeying him were dispersed and came to nothing.

en.L: For before these days Theudas rose up, claiming himself to be somebody, to whom a number of men, about 400, joined themselves; he was killed, and all who followed him were dispersed and came to nothing.
en.B: In days gone by Theudas came forward, making himself out to be someone great, and around 400 men took his side. He was killed, those who had followed his lead were broken up, and nothing was left of it.
en.R: Some time ago a man named Theudas came along. He said he was someone important, and about 400 men joined him. But he was killed. All his followers were scattered, and nothing came of it.

es.L: Porque antes de estos días se levantó Teudas, diciendo que él era alguien, al que se unió un número de unos cuatrocientos hombres; él fue muerto, y todos los que le obedecían se dispersaron y quedaron en nada.
es.B: Hace algún tiempo se presentó Teudas, haciéndose pasar por alguien importante, y unos cuatrocientos hombres se pusieron de su lado. Lo mataron, los que lo habían seguido se dispersaron, y todo aquello quedó en nada.
es.R: Hace un tiempo apareció un hombre llamado Teudas. Decía que era alguien importante, y unos cuatrocientos hombres se unieron a él. Pero lo mataron. Todos sus seguidores se dispersaron, y aquello no llegó a nada.

fr.L: Car avant ces jours-ci se leva Theudas, se disant quelqu’un, auquel se rallia un nombre d’hommes d’environ quatre cents ; il fut tué, et tous ceux qui l’avaient suivi furent dispersés et réduits à rien.
fr.B: Il y a quelque temps, Theudas se fit connaître en se présentant comme un personnage important, et environ quatre cents hommes se rangèrent de son côté. Il fut tué, ceux qui l’avaient suivi furent dispersés, et il n’en resta rien.
fr.R: Il y a quelque temps, un homme appelé Theudas est arrivé. Il disait qu’il était quelqu’un d’important, et environ quatre cents hommes l’ont suivi. Mais il a été tué. Tous ses partisans ont été dispersés, et il n’en est rien resté.

sw.L: Kwa maana kabla ya siku hizi aliinuka Theuda, akisema kwamba yeye ni mtu fulani, ambaye wanaume wapatao mia nne walijiunga naye; yeye aliuawa, na wote waliomtii walitawanyika, wakawa si kitu.
sw.B: Siku za nyuma Theuda alijitokeza, akijifanya kuwa mtu mkubwa, na wanaume wapatao mia nne wakamfuata. Aliuawa, na wale wote waliofuata uongozi wake wakatawanyika, na hakuna kilichobaki.
sw.R: Wakati fulani uliopita, mtu mmoja aitwaye Theuda alitokea. Alisema kwamba yeye ni mtu muhimu, na wanaume wapatao mia nne walijiunga naye. Lakini aliuawa. Wafuasi wake wote walitawanyika, na hakuna kilichotokea.

decisions.choice: Theudas: the leader of a movement before Judas the Galilean, otherwise unknown
decisions.reason: The historian Josephus (Antiquities 20.97-98) tells of a Theudas who claimed to be a prophet and was killed under the governor Fadus, about AD 44-46. That is some ten years after Gamaliel's speech, and long after Judas (AD 6), whom Gamaliel places after Theudas. Gamaliel may mean an earlier leader of the same name; Josephus describes many uprisings after Herod the Great died in 4 BC. The question is not settled.

decisions.choice: claiming to be somebody: claiming to be someone important
decisions.reason: He set himself up as a leader, perhaps as a prophet or a deliverer.

decisions.choice: followed him: were persuaded by him, obeyed him
decisions.reason: The verb means to be persuaded, and so to follow.

decisions.choice: came to nothing: the movement ended with its leader
decisions.reason: This is Gamaliel's point: a movement of merely human origin dies with its leader.

source.text: μετὰ τοῦτον ἀνέστη Ἰούδας ὁ Γαλιλαῖος ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τῆς ἀπογραφῆς καὶ ἀπέστησε λαὸν ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ· κἀκεῖνος ἀπώλετο καὶ πάντες ὅσοι ἐπείθοντο αὐτῷ διεσκορπίσθησαν.

records.literal_gloss: After this one rose up Judas the Galilean in the days of the census and drew away people after him; and that one perished, and all as many as were obeying him were scattered.

en.L: After this man Judas the Galilean rose up in the days of the census and drew away people after him; he too perished, and all who followed him were scattered.
en.B: After him came Judas the Galilean, at the time of the census, who drew a following of people after him. He also perished, and those who had followed his lead were all scattered abroad.
en.R: After that, at the time when the Romans counted the people, Judas from Galilee came along. He got people to follow him. But he died too, and his followers were scattered.

es.L: Después de este se levantó Judas el galileo en los días del censo, y arrastró gente tras de sí; también él pereció, y todos los que le obedecían fueron dispersados.
es.B: Después de él vino Judas el galileo, en tiempos del censo, y arrastró a gente tras de sí. También él pereció, y todos los que lo habían seguido se dispersaron por todas partes.
es.R: Después, en el tiempo en que los romanos contaron a la gente, apareció Judas, de Galilea. Logró que mucha gente lo siguiera. Pero él también murió, y sus seguidores se dispersaron.

fr.L: Après lui se leva Judas le Galiléen, aux jours du recensement, et il entraîna du peuple derrière lui ; lui aussi périt, et tous ceux qui l’avaient suivi furent dispersés.
fr.B: Après lui vint Judas le Galiléen, à l’époque du recensement ; il entraîna du monde à sa suite. Lui aussi périt, et tous ceux qui l’avaient suivi furent dispersés.
fr.R: Ensuite, au moment où les Romains comptaient la population, Judas de Galilée est arrivé. Il a entraîné des gens à le suivre. Mais lui aussi est mort, et ses partisans ont été dispersés.

sw.L: Baada yake aliinuka Yuda Mgalilaya katika siku za kuandikishwa, akawavuta watu wamfuate; naye pia aliangamia, na wote waliomtii walitawanyika.
sw.B: Baada yake alitokea Yuda Mgalilaya, wakati wa kuandikishwa kwa watu, akawavuta watu wamfuate. Yeye naye aliangamia, na wote waliokuwa wamemfuata walitawanyika huku na huko.
sw.R: Baadaye, wakati Warumi walipowahesabu watu, Yuda kutoka Galilaya alitokea. Aliwafanya watu wamfuate. Lakini yeye pia alikufa, na wafuasi wake wakatawanyika.

decisions.choice: Judas the Galilean: the leader of a revolt against Roman rule
decisions.reason: Josephus (Antiquities 18.1-10; Jewish War 2.118) tells how Judas of Galilee urged the Jews to resist the Roman census and not to pay tribute to Rome, saying God alone was their master.

decisions.choice: the census: the Roman registration of people and property for taxes
decisions.reason: Josephus dates it to AD 6, when Judea came under direct Roman rule and Quirinius, governor of Syria, carried out a registration. Luke 2:2 also speaks of a registration under Quirinius.

decisions.choice: drew away people after him: led people into revolt
decisions.reason: The verb means to draw away, here from loyalty to the rulers.

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "people"
alternatives: many manuscripts read "many people" or "much people"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts, followed by the King James Version ("much people"), add a word for many. Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: the time when the Romans counted the people
decisions.reason: Readable says what the census was.

decisions.choice: kuandikishwa (kwa watu)
decisions.reason: The Roman registration of people and property for taxes (meaning decision m2). "Kuandikishwa" (being registered) says what happened; "sensa" is a modern head count.

source.text: καὶ τὰ νῦν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἀπόστητε ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων τούτων καὶ ἄφετε αὐτούς· ὅτι ἐὰν ᾖ ἐξ ἀνθρώπων ἡ βουλὴ αὕτη ἢ τὸ ἔργον τοῦτο, καταλυθήσεται, εἰ δὲ ἐκ θεοῦ ἐστιν, οὐ δυνήσεσθε καταλῦσαι αὐτούς· μήποτε καὶ θεομάχοι εὑρεθῆτε.

records.literal_gloss: And the now I say to you, stand away from the men these and let go them; because if it is from men the plan this or the work this, it will be overthrown, \v 39 if but from God it is, not you will be able to overthrow them, lest even fighters against God you be found.

en.L: And now I say to you, keep away from these men and let them go, because if this plan or this work is from {{gender:people|men}}, it will be overthrown; \v 39 but if it is from God, you will not be able to overthrow them, lest you even be found [to be] fighting against God."
en.B: So here is what I say to you now: keep clear of these men and let them be. If this plan or this work has a human source, it will fall apart, \v 39 but if it comes from God, you will not be able to bring them down. You may even turn out to be at war with God."
en.R: So here is what I tell you. Stay away from these men, and do not do anything to them. If this plan or work comes from people, it will fail. \v 39 But if it comes from God, you will not be able to destroy them. You might even find out that you are fighting against God!"

es.L: Y ahora {{plural_you:les|os}} digo: {{plural_you:apártense|apartaos}} de estos hombres y {{plural_you:déjenlos|dejadlos}}; porque si este plan o esta obra es de {{gender:las personas|los hombres}}, será destruida; \v 39 pero si es de Dios, no {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} destruirlos; no sea que incluso {{plural_you:se encuentren|os encontréis}} luchando contra Dios».
es.B: Por eso, esto es lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} digo ahora: {{plural_you:aléjense|alejaos}} de estos hombres y {{plural_you:déjenlos|dejadlos}} en paz. Si este plan o esta obra es de origen humano, fracasará; \v 39 pero si viene de Dios, no {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} acabar con ellos. Hasta podría resultar que {{plural_you:estén|estéis}} luchando contra Dios».
es.R: Así que esto es lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} digo. {{plural_you:Aléjense|Alejaos}} de estos hombres y no les {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} nada. Si este plan o esta obra viene de la gente, fracasará. \v 39 Pero si viene de Dios, no {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} destruirlos. ¡Hasta {{plural_you:podrían|podríais}} descubrir que {{plural_you:están|estáis}} luchando contra Dios!».

fr.L: Et maintenant, je vous [le] dis, tenez-vous à l’écart de ces hommes et laissez-les, car si ce projet ou cette œuvre vient {{gender:des humains|des hommes}}, il sera détruit ; \v 39 mais si cela vient de Dieu, vous ne pourrez pas les détruire, de peur que vous ne soyez même trouvés en train de combattre contre Dieu. »
fr.B: Voici donc ce que je vous dis maintenant : ne vous occupez plus de ces hommes et laissez-les aller. Si ce projet ou cette œuvre est d’origine humaine, il s’effondrera, \v 39 mais s’il vient de Dieu, vous ne pourrez pas les abattre. Vous risqueriez même de vous retrouver en guerre contre Dieu. »
fr.R: Alors voici ce que je vous dis. Éloignez-vous de ces hommes, et ne leur faites rien. Si ce projet ou ce travail vient des gens, il échouera. \v 39 Mais s’il vient de Dieu, vous ne pourrez pas les détruire. Vous pourriez même découvrir que vous vous battez contre Dieu ! »

sw.L: Basi sasa nawaambia, kaeni mbali na watu hawa, mkawaache; kwa sababu kama mpango huu au kazi hii inatoka kwa wanadamu, itaangushwa; \v 39 lakini kama inatoka kwa Mungu, hamtaweza kuwaangusha; isije ikaonekana kwamba hata mnapigana dhidi ya Mungu."
sw.B: Kwa hiyo, hili ndilo ninalowaambia sasa: kaeni mbali na watu hawa, waacheni. Ikiwa mpango huu au kazi hii ina chanzo cha kibinadamu, itasambaratika; \v 39 lakini ikiwa inatoka kwa Mungu, hamtaweza kuwaangamiza. Huenda hata mkajikuta mnapigana vita na Mungu."
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nawaambia hivi. Kaeni mbali na watu hawa, wala msiwafanyie lolote. Kama mpango huu au kazi hii inatoka kwa watu, itashindwa. \v 39 Lakini kama inatoka kwa Mungu, hamtaweza kuwaangamiza. Huenda hata mkagundua kwamba mnapigana na Mungu!"

decisions.choice: two different forms of "if"
decisions.reason: The first "if" uses a form often used of what may or may not happen; the second uses a form that can take the case as real for the argument. Some read this as Gamaliel leaning toward the second, that the movement is from God. But writers of the time did not always keep the difference, and Gamaliel may simply be cautious.

decisions.choice: lest you be found fighting God: the reason to keep away
decisions.reason: The clause goes back to "keep away from these men" (5:38): leave them alone, so that you are not found fighting against God.

decisions.choice: fighting against God: opponents of God
decisions.reason: One word in the Greek, made of "God" and "fighter".

decisions.choice: from people: of human origin
decisions.reason: The word means human beings, as against God.

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "overthrow them"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts, followed by the King James Version ("ye cannot overthrow it"), have "it", the plan or work. Codex Bezae also adds a longer saying here. Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: people, with "men" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As at 5:4; Balanced and Readable use words that are already inclusive.

decisions.choice: do not do anything to them
decisions.reason: Readable says what letting them go means here: leaving them alone, not punishing them.

source.text: ἐπείσθησαν δὲ αὐτῷ, καὶ προσκαλεσάμενοι τοὺς ἀποστόλους δείραντες παρήγγειλαν μὴ λαλεῖν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἀπέλυσαν.

records.literal_gloss: They were persuaded then by him, \v 40 and having called the apostles, having beaten they commanded not to speak in the name of the Jesus and released [them].

en.L: And they were persuaded by him, \v 40 and having called the apostles in, they beat [them] and commanded [them] not to speak in the name of Jesus, and released [them].
en.B: Gamaliel's words won them over. \v 40 They summoned the apostles, had them beaten, and commanded them to stop speaking in the name of Jesus. Then they released them.
en.R: The council members agreed with Gamaliel. \v 40 They called the apostles back in and had them whipped. They ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus anymore. Then they let them go.

es.L: Y fueron persuadidos por él, \v 40 y llamando a los apóstoles, golpeándo[los], [les] ordenaron no hablar en el nombre de Jesús, y [los] soltaron.
es.B: Las palabras de Gamaliel los convencieron. \v 40 Llamaron a los apóstoles, los hicieron azotar y les ordenaron que dejaran de hablar en el nombre de Jesús. Luego los soltaron.
es.R: Los miembros del Consejo estuvieron de acuerdo con Gamaliel. \v 40 Llamaron otra vez a los apóstoles y los hicieron azotar. Les ordenaron que no hablaran más en el nombre de Jesús. Después los dejaron ir.

fr.L: Et ils se laissèrent persuader par lui, \v 40 et ayant appelé les apôtres, ils [les] firent battre, [leur] ordonnèrent de ne pas parler au nom de Jésus, et [les] relâchèrent.
fr.B: Les paroles de Gamaliel les convainquirent. \v 40 Ils firent venir les apôtres, les firent battre et leur ordonnèrent de cesser de parler au nom de Jésus. Puis ils les relâchèrent.
fr.R: Les membres du grand conseil ont été d’accord avec Gamaliel. \v 40 Ils ont fait revenir les apôtres et les ont fait fouetter. Ils leur ont ordonné de ne plus parler au nom de Jésus. Puis ils les ont laissés partir.

sw.L: Wakashawishiwa naye, \v 40 na walipowaita mitume, wakawapiga, wakawaamuru wasiseme kwa jina la Yesu, wakawaachilia.
sw.B: Maneno ya Gamalieli yaliwashawishi. \v 40 Waliwaita mitume, wakaamuru wapigwe, kisha wakawaamuru waache kusema kwa jina la Yesu. Halafu wakawaachilia.
sw.R: Wajumbe wa baraza kuu walikubaliana na Gamalieli. \v 40 Waliwaita mitume tena, wakaamuru wachapwe viboko. Wakawaamuru wasiseme tena kwa jina la Yesu. Kisha wakawaacha waende zao.

decisions.choice: they were persuaded by him: they took his advice not to kill them
alternatives: they were convinced the apostles were right
decisions.reason: They give up the plan to kill (5:33), but still punish the apostles and repeat their order.

decisions.choice: beat them: likely the Jewish penalty of lashes
decisions.reason: The verb means to beat or flog. The law allowed up to forty lashes (Deuteronomy 25:2-3), and Paul says he received "forty lashes less one" five times (2 Corinthians 11:24). Jesus had warned that his followers would be beaten (Mark 13:9).

decisions.choice: in the name of Jesus: by Jesus's authority, as his messengers
decisions.reason: As in 4:17-18, where they were told not to speak or teach in this name.

decisions.choice: had them whipped
decisions.reason: Readable names the most likely form of the beating, as the meaning note explains.

source.text: οἱ μὲν οὖν ἐπορεύοντο χαίροντες ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ συνεδρίου ὅτι κατηξιώθησαν ὑπὲρ τοῦ ὀνόματος ἀτιμασθῆναι·

records.literal_gloss: They indeed therefore were going rejoicing from presence of the council, because they were counted worthy for the name to be dishonored.

en.L: So they went out from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they had been counted worthy to be dishonored for the sake of the Name.
en.B: As they went out from the council, the apostles were glad: they had been found worthy to bear shame for the sake of the Name.
en.R: The apostles left the council meeting full of joy. God had counted them worthy to suffer shame because they belonged to Jesus.

es.L: Así pues, ellos se iban de delante del concilio alegrándose de que se les había considerado dignos de sufrir deshonra a favor del Nombre.
es.B: Al salir del Consejo, los apóstoles iban contentos, porque se les había considerado dignos de cargar con la vergüenza por causa del Nombre.
es.R: Los apóstoles salieron de la reunión del Consejo Supremo llenos de alegría. Dios los había considerado dignos de sufrir humillación porque pertenecían a Jesús.

fr.L: Eux donc s’en allaient de devant le Sanhédrin, joyeux d’avoir été jugés dignes d’être déshonorés pour le Nom.
fr.B: En quittant le Sanhédrin, les apôtres étaient pleins de joie : ils avaient été jugés dignes de subir la honte pour le Nom.
fr.R: Les apôtres sont sortis de la réunion du grand conseil pleins de joie. Dieu les avait jugés dignes de souffrir la honte parce qu’ils appartenaient à Jésus.

sw.L: Basi wao walikwenda zao wakifurahi, wakitoka mbele ya baraza, kwa kuwa walionwa kuwa wanastahili kuvunjiwa heshima kwa ajili ya Jina.
sw.B: Mitume walitoka barazani wakiwa na furaha, kwa kuwa walikuwa wameonekana kuwa wanafaa kubeba aibu kwa ajili ya Jina.
sw.R: Mitume waliondoka kwenye mkutano wa baraza kuu wakiwa wamejaa furaha. Mungu aliwaona kuwa wanafaa kuteseka kwa aibu kwa sababu walikuwa watu wa Yesu.

decisions.choice: rejoicing in disgrace: as Jesus told them
decisions.reason: Jesus said, "Blessed are you when people hate you ... because of the Son of Man. Rejoice in that day" (Luke 6:22-23).

decisions.choice: counted worthy: by God
decisions.reason: The passive leaves the one who counts unnamed. It is God who honors them, while the council shames them: worthy to be dishonored.

decisions.choice: the Name: the name of Jesus
decisions.reason: The name of Jesus, spoken of alone as a title (3 John 7). The council had forbidden them to speak in it (5:40).

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "the Name"
alternatives: many manuscripts read "his name" or "the name of Jesus"
decisions.reason: Later manuscripts fill out the phrase in several ways; the King James Version has "his name". Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: because they belonged to Jesus
alternatives: for the sake of the Name
decisions.reason: Readable says what suffering for the Name means: they suffered because they were Jesus's own and spoke for him.

decisions.choice: the apostles
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name them.

source.text: πᾶσάν τε ἡμέραν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ καὶ κατ’ οἶκον οὐκ ἐπαύοντο διδάσκοντες καὶ εὐαγγελιζόμενοι τὸν χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν.

records.literal_gloss: Every then day in the temple and by house not they were ceasing teaching and proclaiming good news the Christ Jesus.

en.L: And every day, in the temple and from house to house, they did not cease teaching and proclaiming the good news that the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} [is] Jesus.
en.B: Every day, both in the temple and in people's homes, they went on teaching without a break, and announcing the good news that the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} is Jesus.
en.R: Every day the apostles taught in the temple courts and in people's homes. They never stopped telling the good news that Jesus is the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.

es.L: Y todos los días, en el templo y por las casas, no cesaban de enseñar y de anunciar la buena noticia de que el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} [es] Jesús.
es.B: Cada día, tanto en el templo como en las casas, seguían enseñando sin descanso y anunciando la buena noticia de que el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} es Jesús.
es.R: Todos los días los apóstoles enseñaban en los patios del templo y en las casas de la gente. Nunca dejaban de contar la buena noticia de que Jesús es el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}.

fr.L: Et chaque jour, dans le temple et de maison en maison, ils ne cessaient d’enseigner et d’annoncer la bonne nouvelle que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, [c’est] Jésus.
fr.B: Chaque jour, dans la cour du temple comme dans les maisons, ils continuaient sans relâche à enseigner et à annoncer la bonne nouvelle : le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, c’est Jésus.
fr.R: Chaque jour, les apôtres enseignaient dans la cour du temple et dans les maisons des gens. Ils n’arrêtaient jamais d’annoncer la bonne nouvelle : Jésus est le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.

sw.L: Na kila siku, hekaluni na nyumba kwa nyumba, hawakuacha kufundisha na kuhubiri habari njema kwamba {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} [ni] Yesu.
sw.B: Kila siku, hekaluni na katika nyumba za watu, waliendelea kufundisha bila kukoma, na kuhubiri habari njema kwamba {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ni Yesu.
sw.R: Kila siku mitume walifundisha katika nyua za hekalu na katika nyumba za watu. Hawakuacha kamwe kuwaeleza watu habari njema kwamba Yesu ni {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.

decisions.choice: proclaiming the Christ, Jesus: that the Messiah is Jesus
alternatives: proclaiming Christ Jesus as a name
decisions.reason: With the article, "the Christ" is the title: the Messiah Israel awaited. The message is that he is Jesus, as in 17:3 and 18:5, 18:28. It is not yet used here as a name.

decisions.choice: proclaiming the good news: announcing good news
decisions.reason: The verb is formed from the word for good news. Luke uses it often for telling the message of Jesus (8:4, 8:35).

decisions.choice: from house to house: in homes as well as the temple
decisions.reason: As in 2:46. They obey God rather than the council (5:29).

decisions.choice: the Christ is Jesus (B); Jesus is the Christ (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the Greek order, which makes "the Christ" plainly a title; Readable uses the usual English order for the same statement.

decisions.choice: anunciar la buena noticia
decisions.reason: The verb means to announce good news (meaning decision m2), said here in the words used for it across the New Testament drafts; the news itself follows: that the Messiah is Jesus (m1).

decisions.choice: kuhubiri habari njema
decisions.reason: The verb means to announce good news (meaning decision m2), said here in the words used for it across the New Testament drafts; the news itself follows: that the Messiah is Jesus (m1).
